lead: Building a gap can make a `designed` rule owed the same session, and the gap register does not say so.
body: Striking `crates/nvs-runtime/src/lib.rs`'s "`nvs_safepoint` clears `COLLECT`" gap made `rule:observability/gc-pause-is-its-own-event` — a rule that had been unreachable prose because the collector did not exist — true of the routine that now does, and nothing in `owners.py`'s list pointed at it. Before closing a gap that builds a *mechanism*, grep `docs/rules/` for the mechanism's noun and check every `"status": "designed"` rule it hits: each is either owed in the same slice or a gap that needs an owner.
